key: Place each finding by the link it reveals: a uterus means no AMH was made, female genitalia with testes mean androgen cannot act, ambiguity that virilizes means low DHT, and the karyotype separates the sex chromosome disorders.
items: Aromatized testosterone grows breasts, but pubic hair needs androgen action, which the defective receptor blocks.
Testis found in an inguinal hernia of a girl
Testes form normally and often sit in the inguinal canal of a phenotypic girl with this receptor defect.
High testosterone and high LH with female genitalia
The hypothalamus and pituitary ignore testosterone too, so LH climbs and testosterone rises without any androgen effect.
Ambiguous genitalia at birth, virilization at puberty
Genital formation needs DHT, but the pubertal testosterone surge acts on the receptor directly and virilizes.
Normal testosterone with a low DHT
The missing enzyme converts testosterone to DHT, so testosterone is normal and its ratio to DHT is high.
The enzyme defect needs two mutant copies, unlike the X-linked inheritance of androgen insensitivity.
46,XY with a uterus and no breasts
Streak gonads make neither AMH nor estrogen, so a uterus forms and breasts never develop.
Without SRY the gonad never becomes a testis and stays a streak in a 46,XY person.
Dysgenetic gonads that carry Y material can form gonadoblastoma, so they are removed at diagnosis.
Short stature with a webbed neck
SHOX loss causes short stature, and a resolved fetal cystic hygroma leaves the webbed neck.
Aortic coarctation and a bicuspid aortic valve are the dangerous cardiovascular lesions of 45,X.
Kidneys fused at their lower poles form a horseshoe kidney, a classic renal anomaly of 45,X.
Tubular hyalinization shrinks the testes, and low testosterone delays growth-plate closure, so height increases.
Low inhibin B with high FSH
Damaged Sertoli cells make little inhibin B, which removes the brake on pituitary FSH.
The extra inactivated X of 47,XXY shows as a Barr body, which normal male cells lack.
